actions.title: List saved MongoDB connections
actions.summary: Lists the MongoDB connections saved in the MongoDB panel: id, name, hosts, auth mechanism and user. Never returns passwords, keys or tokens. If none is saved, ask the user to add one in the MongoDB panel with F7.

id.description: Stable id; always unambiguous as a 'connection' argument

name.description: Display name; also accepted as a 'connection' argument

hosts.description: Scheme and hosts of the connection string, plus the SSH or SOCKS host it goes through

auth.description: none, password, SCRAM-SHA-256, SCRAM-SHA-1, PLAIN, GSSAPI, MONGODB-X509, MONGODB-AWS or MONGODB-OIDC

actions.title: List MongoDB databases
actions.summary: Lists the databases of a saved connection that the user may see, with their size on disk.

connection.description: Saved connection id or name (see mongo.connections.list)

sizeBytes.description: Size on disk; null when the server did not say

actions.title: List MongoDB collections
actions.summary: Lists the collections, views and time series collections of a database, with estimated document counts.

nameLike.description: Name pattern with * wildcards, matched ignoring case, e.g. 'order*'

docs.description: Estimated document count from metadata; null for views and when there are over 200 collections

viewOn.description: Views only: the collection the view reads

timeField.description: Time series only: the time field

capped.description: Present and true for a capped collection

truncated.description: Whether the limit cut the list

actions.title: Sample a collection's schema
actions.summary: Describes the shape of a collection's documents from a random sample: every field path with its BSON types and how often it occurs, plus the indexes, the validator and, for a view, its pipeline.

collection.description: Collection, view or time series collection

path.description: Dotted path as queries write it; fields of documents inside arrays included

frequency.description: Share of sampled documents that have the field, 0 to 1

types.description: BSON type name to occurrences, e.g. {"string": 97, "null": 3}

itemTypes.description: Arrays only: type name of their items to occurrences

fieldsTruncated.description: Present and true when over 2000 field paths were seen

indexes.description: The collection's indexes as listIndexes returns them; not for views

validator.description: The JSON schema or query validator, if any

actions.title: Count MongoDB documents
actions.summary: Counts the documents of a collection exactly, all of them or those matching a query filter.

filter.description: Query filter, e.g. {"status": "failed"}; Extended JSON such as {"$date": ...} and {"$oid": ...} allowed; omitted counts everything

actions.title: Find MongoDB documents
actions.summary: Runs a read-only find on a collection or view: query filter, projection, sort, skip and limit. Returns the documents as relaxed Extended JSON.

documents.description: Documents in relaxed Extended JSON; a stand-in with _id and leftOut when one alone is over the size budget

truncated.description: Whether the size budget dropped documents; ask for fewer fields

actions.title: Run a MongoDB aggregation
actions.summary: Runs a read-only aggregation pipeline on a collection or view: $match, $group, $lookup, $facet and every other stage except $out and $merge, which write and are refused.

truncated.description: Whether the size budget dropped results

limitReached.description: Present and true when the pipeline may have more results than limit
